{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 with NaN
data['biomarker_final'] = data['biomarker_final'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check that both male and female patients exist
print("Gender distribution:", data['sex'].value_counts())

# Check that treatment and control arms exist
print("Arm distribution:", data['arm'].value_counts())

# Check the response variable
print("Response distribution:", data['responded'].value_counts())"}
